description: AION 2 dungeons for the Guide (phase 4): entry, difficulties, cycles and short boss notes, in our own words. Loot lists live in gear-sources.json (phase 3); lootRef points there.

weekly.text: Weekly entries and reward limits reset every Wednesday at 07:00 UTC.

daily.text: Daily attempts and keys refill at 07:00 UTC.

conflicts: The Dungeons overview also says 5:00 AM with no time zone. We use 07:00 UTC, which the Nightmare and Ascension Trial pages give and an in game check confirms.

categories.name: Expedition
categories.entryCycle: Spend Odyle Energy on the reward

categories.name: Sealed Dungeons and Strongholds
categories.mainRewards: Daevanion Crystals, Enhance Stones, Noble Belt scrolls

categories.name: Ascension Trial
categories.mainRewards: Enhance Stones, Amplify Stone Fragments, chests

cycle.text: No entry limit. You spend Odyle Energy only when you open the reward cube after the final boss. Each claim adds to your cube count; on Conquest enough claims give a Condensed Cube Energy pick of one Unique item. On Exploration that pick is limited.

records.name: Krao Cave
records.summary: The first Expedition. A short cave run with a simple route: two mid-bosses on a fork, then a sealed creation as the final boss.

difficulties.name: Exploration
difficulties.note: A gentle version for learning the bosses.

difficulties.name: Conquest
difficulties.note: The usual farm. The final boss gains one-hit kill attacks.

conflicts: The Expedition list page gives Conquest item level 800; the Krao Cave page gives 700. We show 700 from the dungeon page.

extra.title: Dungeon livestream confirms level cap of 45

bosses.name: Neglected Gadioton
bosses.note: Ranged. Wide fire zones you can read early; its pull then blast is the one to respect.

bosses.name: Enhanced Harcon
bosses.note: Melee. Summons snipers around the edge that fire crossing lines; look for the gaps.

bosses.name: Ultimate Berk
bosses.note: Stand behind it to dodge the sweep, run to the edge when its hands turn red, and jump a beat early over the waves in the stagger phase.

provenance.title: Dungeon livestream confirms level cap of 45

cycle.text: No entry limit. You spend Odyle Energy only when you open the reward cube after the final boss. Each claim adds to your cube count; on Conquest enough claims give a Condensed Cube Energy pick of one Unique item. On Exploration that pick is limited.

records.rewardFocus: Unique armour and a Guard (item Lv 54)
records.name: Draupnir
records.summary: A three floor dive whose entrance sits in the Abyss, the PvP zone. Clearing Exploration once in the main quest gives a Unique weapon for your class. Expect gliding, flying and Kisk hops.

difficulties.name: Exploration
difficulties.note: Learn the route and the bosses.

difficulties.name: Conquest
difficulties.note: Stronger bosses with one-hit kill attacks.

extraRewards: Ten clears give a Pantheon item.

bosses.name: Predator Saraswati
bosses.note: Poison pools that stack fast, plus bind then poison cone. Watch your HP.

bosses.name: Phantasmal Lakshmi
bosses.note: Stop hitting it while it reflects. Below half HP kill the healing handmaidens first.

bosses.name: Transcendent Bakarma
bosses.note: Stay behind it. At two thirds and one third HP, jump the waves early, reach it fast and break its whole stagger bar in time or the party wipes.

cycle.text: No entry limit. You spend Odyle Energy only when you open the reward cube after the final boss. Each claim adds to your cube count; on Conquest enough claims give a Condensed Cube Energy pick of one Unique item. On Exploration that pick is limited.

records.name: Urugugu Canyon
records.summary: A canyon in Tolbas Forest crossed with windstreams and gliding. Easy on Exploration; on Conquest the final boss has a hard damage check.

difficulties.name: Exploration
difficulties.note: Learn the route and the bosses.

difficulties.name: Conquest
difficulties.note: Packed trash and a very high damage check on the final boss.

bosses.name: Guardian Captain Raur
bosses.note: Do not hit into its shield counter stance; watch for a charge with no warning.

bosses.name: Judge Urahum
bosses.note: Wide hits and poison zones, no wipe mechanic.

bosses.name: Divine Auldor
bosses.note: Glide in carefully: a missed glide starts the fight with less HP. Whirlwind combos, a one-hit kill attack and an enrage timer.

cycle.text: No entry limit. You spend Odyle Energy only when you open the reward cube after the final boss. Each claim adds to your cube count; on Conquest enough claims give a Condensed Cube Energy pick of one Unique item. On Exploration that pick is limited.

records.rewardFocus: Unique armour and a Guard (item Lv 70)
records.name: Vakron Sky Island
records.summary: The first optional Expedition, off the main quest route. It needs at least two players because some mechanics cannot be broken alone. Conquest drops a Guard, which few dungeons give.

difficulties.name: Exploration
difficulties.note: Learn the route, the element puzzle and the bosses.

difficulties.name: Conquest
difficulties.note: Stronger wipe mechanics; groups often ask for more than the entry item level.

bosses.name: Tiere
bosses.note: Venom debuff and a dodge pattern that turns clockwise.

bosses.name: Thamon
bosses.note: Petrify and bind; it heals depending on the attack type it takes.

bosses.name: Vakron
bosses.note: Binds that spread, a jump and glide wipe check, a rock prison and an enrage. Clear the Surveillance stacks at Mist Spirit Stones on the way.

cycle.text: No entry limit. You spend Odyle Energy only when you open the reward cube after the final boss. Each claim adds to your cube count; on Conquest enough claims give a Condensed Cube Energy pick of one Unique item. On Exploration that pick is limited.

records.rewardFocus: Unique extendable weapons and accessories (item Lv 86)
records.name: Fire Temple
records.summary: A lava temple full of Burn. Clearly harder than the earlier Expeditions, and the home of the extendable weapons that widen your reach.

difficulties.name: Exploration
difficulties.note: Learn the coolant route and the bosses.

difficulties.name: Conquest
difficulties.note: Heavy damage and a very high damage check on the final boss.

records.prepare: Bring healing and cleansing potions for Burn, plus speed, defence and damage scrolls and food for the final boss.

bosses.name: Black Smoke Murute
bosses.note: Mostly ground zones. The easiest of the three.

bosses.name: Red Spark Ignus
bosses.note: Curse of Flame and zones that need the party to spread out.

bosses.name: Kromede's Desire
bosses.note: Chained attacks, bow attacks and the Fire Curtain, with a very high damage check.

cycle.text: No entry limit. You spend Odyle Energy only when you open the reward cube after the final boss. Each claim adds to your cube count; on Conquest enough claims give a Condensed Cube Energy pick of one Unique item. On Exploration that pick is limited.

records.rewardFocus: Unique armour and a Guard (item Lv 86)
records.name: Ferocious Horn Den
records.summary: The last Expedition gate and the most teamwork heavy. It drops the best Unique Expedition armour and the highest scoring Unique Guard.

difficulties.name: Exploration
difficulties.note: Learn the route, the bombs and the bosses.

difficulties.name: Conquest
difficulties.note: Many shared mechanics and heavy basic attacks; groups often ask for more than the entry item level.

bosses.name: Watchdog Kwapo
bosses.note: Tracking orbs and an orb collecting mechanic.

bosses.name: Glowing Mau Totem
bosses.note: Survive the waves and use bombs on the Totemists. It gives no extra loot but opens the way.

bosses.name: Necromancer Duanka
bosses.note: Ranged. Kill the spirits and handle its soul calling wipe check.

bosses.name: Nuakum the Ferocious Horn
bosses.note: Clone assaults, guiding a blue orb and blocking for allies. Keep damage taken low.

records.name: Deus Research Base
records.summary: A Transcendence dungeon and the only home of Compass and Bell Arcana. Watch the drops along the route and the chain binds of the final boss.
records.levelNote: No character level is listed for Transcendence: item level is the gate.

effect.name: Balance
effect.text: Strong elites leave a zone when they die that boosts monsters and hurts you.

effect.name: Rage
effect.text: Monsters that are not bosses hit harder below half HP.

effect.name: Judgment
effect.text: Boss hits stack a mark that explodes for damage to those near you.

cycle.text: Every Stage is open from the start. Kina from runs drops after the first 55 clears in a week; the count resets on Wednesday.

records.rewardFocus: Arcana (Compass, Bell, Chalice), Theostones, Manastones and Soulstones
records.rank: Each clear gets a Rank from time, revives, Kisks used and monsters killed. Monsters killed after the final boss spawns do not count.

bosses.name: Gelcos
bosses.note: Take the left path at the first fork.

bosses.name: Nazmun
bosses.note: Further along the same path.

bosses.name: Atiel
bosses.note: Kill the set number of monsters first. Its chains bind players together: hold position until they break, or move away from the centre player when the whole party is bound.

records.name: Shattered Arkanis
records.summary: A Transcendence dungeon and the only home of Mirror and Parchment Arcana. Many ranged trash mobs, so do not pull too many at once on high Stages.
records.levelNote: No character level is listed for Transcendence: item level is the gate.

effect.name: Poison Blood
effect.text: Strong elites leave a zone when they die that heals monsters and hurts you.

effect.name: Elevation
effect.text: When a monster dies, nearby monsters hit harder.

effect.name: Tolerance
effect.text: Bosses have a bigger stagger bar.

cycle.text: Every Stage is open from the start. Kina from runs drops after the first 55 clears in a week; the count resets on Wednesday.

records.rewardFocus: Arcana (Mirror, Parchment, Chalice), Theostones, Manastones and Soulstones
records.rank: Each clear gets a Rank from time, revives, Kisks used and monsters killed. Monsters killed after the final boss spawns do not count.

bosses.name: Siliator of Deceit
bosses.note: Up the stairs on the left. Higher Stages add a frost zone.

bosses.name: Ruthilis of Pain
bosses.note: Further along the path.

bosses.name: Talisra of the Void
bosses.note: Appears after the kill count. Guide its Refracting Spear into the crystals to free trapped allies; top Stages add moving fire pillars.

records.name: Nightmare
records.summary: Solo boss fights straight from the menu. Each boss has ten challenge levels; clears pay Phantasmal Fragments for the Nightmare shop.

difficulties.name: the two Rare bosses
difficulties.note: Clear all four Common bosses at level 10 first.

difficulties.name: Zikel's Apparition (Epic)
difficulties.note: Clear both Rare bosses at level 10 first.

records.itemLevelNote: These item levels are suggestions for challenge levels 1 to 10, not entry gates.

cycle.text: Two attempts a day at the daily reset, stacking to 14. An attempt is spent only when you win, so a failed try costs nothing.

records.rewardFocus: Phantasmal Fragments for the Nightmare shop (Daevanion Crystals, Stigma Shards, wings)
conflicts: The Dungeons overview says the daily recharge is at 5:00 AM and that an attempt is used on entry; the Nightmare page says 07:00 UTC and only on a clear. We follow the Nightmare page.

bosses.name: Zikel's Apparition
bosses.note: Fast and punishing. Wait for the first line to explode then dash through it, jump just before the floor gauge fills, and step out of sword circles.

records.name: Ascension Trial
records.summary: A solo timed run through rooms to a final boss, scored at the end. Side objectives buff you or weaken the boss. The dungeon changes each week.

difficulties.name: Extreme
difficulties.note: 2 deaths allowed, 13 minutes. Wrath: monsters below half HP hit harder.

cycle.text: Three entries a week. An entry is spent the moment you go in, win or lose, so pick a difficulty you can finish.

records.rewardFocus: Enhance Stones, Unique Amplify Stone Fragments, Growth Pet Chests and Ascension Binding Chests

records.name: Daily Dungeon
records.summary: Solo waves against the clock. Pick one of three random combat boosts during the run; your score sets the reward. Despite the name it refills weekly.
records.entryPending: No entry level or item level listed yet.

cycle.text: 14 attempts a week, refilled on Wednesday.

records.name: Sealed Dungeons and Strongholds
records.summary: Solo spots marked with a question mark on the map. Sealed Dungeons are small caves of about ten minutes; Strongholds are enemy bases with two or three objectives. Each pays out once.
records.entryPending: No level gate is listed. Loot from mobs scales with your level, so they are best done at Lv 45; the fixed rewards do not change.

cycle.text: Each one is cleared once and its marker leaves the map. Kina and some items have a daily cap shared with field hunting.

records.rewardFocus: Daevanion Crystals, Wisdom Stones, Enhance Stones, titles, and Noble Belt Enhance Scrolls from Strongholds
records.daevaGauge: Clears fill the Daeva Gauge. At 100% the final main quest opens.

records.name: Shugo Festival
records.summary: Nine five minute mini games every hour on the hour: flying, racing, memory and hide and seek. Gear does not matter, only your rank.

cycle.text: Three Reward Keys a day per server, up to 12. A key is spent only when you open a reward card, so you can skip a poor result.

records.rewardFocus: Centuryroot Tokens, Enhance Stones, Soul Codex, Abyss Points and a small chance of Unique gear

records.name: Sanctuary
records.summary: The end game raid for two parties. Its entry rules and bosses are not listed yet.
records.entryPending: Entry level, item level and bosses not listed yet.
conflicts: The Dungeons overview says 8 players in 2 parties; the Expedition page says 10 player raids. We show 8 from the overview.

cycle.text: Final boss kills are limited each week.

records.rewardFocus: Top tier gear and crafting materials (pending detail)
